title: Netflix TV v1.4.6
changelog: Automatically hide Netflix OSD controls and timeline scrubber during embedded streaming server playback for direct native interaction
Removed invisible tap interceptor overlay in iframe mode so clicks, scrubbing, volume, and server buttons work directly on the embedded player
Added non-intrusive auto-dimming floating Exit/Back header and Server Switcher pill in top bar for seamless catalog navigation
Fixed Protected Admin Access authentication for master password Bolt@256 (case-insensitive) with instant client-side authorization and clean error formatting
Preserved Virtual Remote Cursor support for TV D-Pad remotes and full Netflix custom OSD for direct streams
